# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_hold_exploration.py". Change the tables there and re-run.
# Province scope.

DA_HX_select_pathfinders = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
}

DA_HX_select_wardens = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	set_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
}

DA_HX_select_prospectors = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	set_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
}

DA_HX_select_loreseekers = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	set_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
}

# called at the end of the roll (DA_Hold_exploration_workaround): the charter has done its work
DA_HX_end_roll = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
}

# The Send button. The company leaves now; the floor table rolls when the modifier of its way down has run out.
DA_HX_send = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_2 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { add_treasury = -40 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_treasury = -25 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_send_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			DA_HX_end_roll = yes
			remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			set_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
		}
	}
	else_if = {

# The country menu (DA_adk_hold_exploration_menu.1). The AI keeps the old pace; a player's company travels like any
# Pathfinder company. The floor is found the way DA_Hold_exploration_workaround finds it.
DA_HX_depart_from_menu = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
		DA_HX_end_roll = yes
		remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
		if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_1_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_2 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_2_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_3 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_3_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_4 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 50 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_4_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_5 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 65 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_5_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_6 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 80 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_6_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_7 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 95 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_7_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_8 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 110 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_8_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_9 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 125 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_9_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_10 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 140 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_10_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_11 } }
			add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 155 }
		}
	}
	set_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
}

# on_conquest: the reset stays total. The lost works already found are remembered by their own flags, as before.
DA_HX_reset = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_open
	remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
